topic: How to time your own wealth luck: your Day Master element, the five-line control table, applied to hour, day, month and year, with the Mirror's warning that one perspective is never enough.
phrases: When am I going to make money?
The rule tells you where to look. It doesn't let you stop looking.

images.concept: Reading time: an hourglass beside a handwritten notebook.
images.prompt: A warm cinematic still life. An old brass hourglass stands on a dark weathered wooden table beside an open notebook filled with faint, unreadable handwriting and a fountain pen. Antique gold lamplight from one side, midnight jade shadow behind. Patient and exact. No people. No legible writing. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman working it out for herself at the kitchen table.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of a woman seen from behind at a kitchen table in early morning, a cup of tea and a small notebook in front of her, pen in hand, her face turned away from the camera. Soft antique gold window light, dusty rose cardigan, midnight jade cabinet in the background. Quiet concentration. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Card-style text image of the question Bill hears most.
images.text: When am I going to make money?
images.prompt: An elegant typographic image on a warm ivory background with a faint parchment texture and thin antique gold filigree at the corners. Centered text in refined serif lettering, deep plum ink: "When am I going to make money?" Spell every word perfectly. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Five candles, only some lit: all the factors have to come into play.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of five plain candles of different heights in a row on a dark wooden table; two are lit, three are not yet. Antique gold glow, deep midnight jade background, a thin curl of smoke. Anticipation rather than celebration. No people. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman before a mirror, more than one way of seeing.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of a woman seen from behind standing before a tall antique mirror in a dim room, the reflection softened into shadow so her face cannot be seen. Antique gold frame, midnight jade walls, a single warm lamp. Mysterious and calm. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
